world_atlas.setting.minimap.tooltip: The small map in a corner of the screen. The Toggle minimap key (N) flips this too.
world_atlas.setting.minimap_size.tooltip: The minimap's side in GUI pixels.
world_atlas.setting.minimap_zoom.tooltip: How close the minimap looks. At 1x one GUI pixel is one block.
world_atlas.setting.coords.tooltip: Your X Y Z under the minimap.
world_atlas.setting.beams.tooltip: Draw a coloured beam in the world at each waypoint whose own Beam switch is on. Off: no beams at all. The world map's bar switches this too.
world_atlas.setting.labels.tooltip: Show each waypoint's name and distance where it is on the screen. Off: no labels in the world.
world_atlas.setting.death.tooltip: Mark where you die with a "Death" waypoint. The last few are kept (Deaths kept): "Death" is the newest, then "Death 2", "Death 3".
world_atlas.setting.deaths_kept.tooltip: How many death waypoints are kept, newest first. The oldest goes when a new death would be one too many.
world_atlas.setting.beam_near.tooltip: A waypoint's beam fades out as you come this close to it (horizontally), so it is not in your way when you are there.
world_atlas.setting.beam_far.tooltip: Beams of waypoints further away than this fade out (over the last quarter of the distance).
world_atlas.setting.hover_names.tooltip: Show a waypoint's name on the world map only under the cursor, and its label in the world only when you look towards it.
world_atlas.setting.minimap_corner.toolt: Which corner of the screen the minimap sits in.
world_atlas.setting.minimap_round.toolti: A round minimap instead of a square one.
world_atlas.setting.minimap_rotate.toolt: The way you look is up on the minimap. Off: north is up.
world_atlas.setting.hide_in_f3.tooltip: The minimap steps aside while the F3 debug screen covers its corner, and the compass bar and direction arrow while F3 is open.
world_atlas.setting.hide_in_screens.tool: The minimap, compass bar and direction arrow step aside while chat, the inventory, a menu or another mod's screen is open.
world_atlas.setting.other_coords.tooltip: A second line under the minimap: where you would be in the Nether (in the Overworld: X and Z divided by 8) or in the Overworld (in the Nether: times 8).
world_atlas.setting.layer.tooltip: Auto shows the cave layer at your height while you are under ground or under the Nether's roof, the surface otherwise. The world map's bar switches this too.
world_atlas.setting.biome_colors.tooltip: Grass, leaves and water in the colours their biome gives them. Off: a map item's fixed colours.
world_atlas.setting.radar_hostile.toolti: Red dots on the maps for hostile mobs the game shows you nearby.
world_atlas.setting.radar_passive.toolti: Green dots on the maps for animals, villagers and other mobs nearby.
world_atlas.setting.radar_players.toolti: White dots on the maps for other players nearby; the world map names the one under the cursor.
world_atlas.setting.radar_items.tooltip: Small yellow dots on the maps for items lying nearby.
world_atlas.setting.spawn.tooltip: Keep a "Spawn" waypoint at the world spawn. Single player and LAN host only: a server does not tell.
world_atlas.setting.bed.tooltip: Keep a "Bed" waypoint at your respawn point (bed or respawn anchor).
world_atlas.setting.arrow.tooltip: An arrow at the top of the screen pointing to the tracked waypoint, with its distance. Pick the waypoint with Track in its bubble on the world map.
world_atlas.setting.teleport.tooltip: Adds Teleport to a waypoint's bubble on the world map: it sends /tp, so it needs cheats in a single-player world or operator rights on a server. Off by default.
world_atlas.setting.compass.tooltip: A slim compass at the top of the screen: the directions and this dimension's waypoints slide along it as you turn. The tracked waypoint is larger, with its name and distance. Takes the direction arrow's place; boss bars move down under it.
world_atlas.setting.radar_style.tooltip: Faces: each mob's own face, cut from the game's textures (a resource pack changes them too), and a dropped item's icon. Dots: plain coloured dots.
world_atlas.setting.radar_hover.tooltip: On the world map, show the name of the mob, player or item under the cursor.
